notes: Two taḥwīl branches meet at Ibn Juraij: the names from Abu Zubayr to Ibn Abbas are written once: shared tail
The editor's gloss «- واللفظ له -» is left out; «محمد بن، بكر» keeps the stray comma as written
«قال فأدركت» is a trailing remark, not a link; «مولى ابن عباس» describes Ikrima and is not part of his name
